title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Re: Patch. They are different colors. Navy blue, white font,orange circle. What are home colors?
Same design. Colors different because of jersey colors. Home is white letters on midnight navy blue (because of white jersey).

Can you are you willing to participate in Journ██ism Day on April 27 prior to game vs Mariners at 1:10pm? You would t██k about why you wanted to become a reporter, your job responsibilities, etc. I am ██so speaking. Jen Hammond is hosting. You should do it.
